research_rationale:
EO 12200 of March 12, 1980 (45 FR 16443, March 14, 1980) adjusts the pay-schedule order EO 12165: it adds footnotes on appropriations limits, substitutes revised Schedules 1 through 7, corrects one statutory reference, and adds Schedule 8 (judicial salaries). Executive Order 12248 of October 16, 1980 (45 FR 69199, October 20, 1980), sec. 1-202, provides in the held Federal Register text layer: "Executive O rders No. 12165 of October 12,1979 and"; line break; "No. 12200 of M arch 12,1980 are superseded." Every clause of 12200 is a pay-rate or schedule command that 12248 replaces with new schedules for the same pay systems, so the whole order ended by express supersession. The Office of the Federal Register catalog note held in the status history also records "Superseded by: EO 12248, October 16, 1980". The recorded first end is the 1980-10-16 date of the superseding order; 12248 sec. 1-201 made the new rates effective October 1, 1980 for the uniformed services and from the first applicable pay period beginning on or after October 1, 1980 for other pay, so the replaced rates stopped operating up to about two weeks before the signing date; a reviewer should note this earlier effective reading. 12248 recites 12165 as "of October 12, 1979" whereas 12200 gives October 9, 1979; the order number and the date March 12, 1980 identify 12200 unambiguously. The APP transcription of 12248 reads the same: Executive Orders No. 12165 of October 12, 1979 and No. 12200 of March 12, 1980 are superseded.
